# rutter

> Recall past decisions and the notes your AI session cited. rutter keeps dated
> records in your own markdown notes folder, each with a content hash of the
> notes it cites. An MCP server for Claude Code, Grok, Codex, and Antigravity;
> a personal reference implementation.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://ruttermemory.com/): what rutter is and the idea behind it
- [Getting started](https://ruttermemory.com/getting-started.html): a setup path for each client, from install to first recall
- [Memory of use](https://ruttermemory.com/memory-of-use.html): capture, recall, enrichment, note identity, positions

## Optional

- [Source hashes](https://ruttermemory.com/sources.json): content hashes of the docs this site was built from
